notes.subject: והתהללו
notes.rationale: Root הלל: 'go phaphatha/ go tšhoga' (JPS 'rush madly') kgahlanong le 'go ikakaretša' (YLT 'boast'); mo go tšwa go sego boikakaretši, ke go rhuba ka maatla.

notes.subject: דרכי קשת
notes.rationale: 'Ba ba tlodišago uta' — go tlodiša uta go dirwa ka go e kena maoto; KJV oketša 'and bend' ka go feta ga Seheberu.

notes.subject: עלו ... ויצאו
notes.rationale: Go boela goba ga go rwala ('phahlang ... di tšwe') go hlagisa sebopego sa taolo ya mabala, se se tlwaelegilego mafoko a sesole.

notes.subject: taolo ya sesole
notes.rationale: Medimo ye e lebelo lefaseng ka go bitša sesole sa Metsri go tsena maemong a ntlha.

translation: Phahlang, dihela, gomme dithaere di phaphathe, gomme dihlabela di tšwe;kus, gomme a šala go lokolla dimošomo; letswai le a tšwa, gomme a ralala le noka ya Perate.
